question: Change the consumererror type from wrapping a simple error to a structured ErrorData type that includes the failed data (metrics/traces/logs) for retry. Any code that type-asserts or unwraps consumer errors will break.

analysis.change_description: The proposed change restructures the core `consumererror.Error` type from wrapping a simple `error` interface to a structured `ErrorData` type that includes the failed telemetry data (metrics/traces/logs) for retry purposes. This is a deeply breaking API change because `consumererror.Error` is the central error type used across the entire collector pipeline — from receivers through processors to exporters.

consumererror.Error.current_structure: Struct embedding `error` interface, with fields: httpStatus (int), grpcStatus (*status.Status), isRetryable (bool). Constructed via NewOTLPHTTPError(), NewOTLPGRPCError(), NewRetryableError(). Implements Error(), Unwrap(), IsRetryable().
consumererror.Error.impact: Any code doing `errors.As(err, &consumererror.Error{})` or `var e *consumererror.Error; errors.As(err, &e)` will break because the struct layout and type change. The Unwrap() method returns a different structure. All constructor functions (NewOTLPHTTPError, NewOTLPGRPCError, NewRetryableError) need new signatures to accept data payloads.

consumererror.Traces/Logs/Metrics.current_structure: Signal-specific error types in signalerrors.go that embed internal.Retryable[T]. These already carry failed data (via Data() method) and wrap the error through NewRetryableError(). Constructed via NewTraces(err, data), NewLogs(err, data), NewMetrics(err, data).
consumererror.Traces/Logs/Metrics.impact: These types already represent the structured ErrorData pattern for retry. If the base Error type changes to include data, these signal-specific types either merge into the new Error type or need to be rearchitected. All code using errors.As with these types breaks.
files_with_type_assertions: exporter/exporterhelper/internal/queuebatch/traces.go (OnError uses errors.As with consumererror.Traces to extract Data() for retry)
exporter/exporterhelper/internal/queuebatch/logs.go (OnError uses errors.As with consumererror.Logs to extract Data() for retry)
exporter/exporterhelper/internal/queuebatch/metrics.go (OnError uses errors.As with consumererror.Metrics to extract Data() for retry)
exporter/exporterhelper/xexporterhelper/profiles.go (OnError uses errors.As with xconsumererror.Profiles to extract Data() for retry)

consumererror.permanent.current_structure: Unexported type wrapping an error. Created via NewPermanent(err), checked via IsPermanent(err) using errors.As.
consumererror.permanent.impact: If Error becomes structured, permanent wrapping logic may need to carry the structured ErrorData instead of a plain error. IsPermanent() traverses the error chain — if the chain structure changes, this breaks.

consumererror.downstreamError.current_structure: Unexported type wrapping an error. Created via NewDownstream(err), checked via IsDownstream(err) using errors.As.
consumererror.downstreamError.impact: Same as permanent — the downstream wrapper may need to carry structured data. IsDownstream() traverses the error chain and would be affected by structural changes.

internal.Retryable[V].current_structure: Generic struct with Err (error) and Value (V, constrained to ptrace.Traces|pmetric.Metrics|plog.Logs|pprofile.Profiles). Implements Error(), Unwrap(), Data().
internal.Retryable[V].impact: This is the internal building block for signal-specific errors. If ErrorData is introduced at the consumererror.Error level, this type either becomes redundant or needs to be refactored to use the new ErrorData type.

breaking_patterns.description: Type assertion to extract the Error struct for accessing httpStatus, grpcStatus, isRetryable fields
Type assertion to extract signal-specific error and call Data() for retry with failed trace data
Type assertion to extract signal-specific error and call Data() for retry with failed log data
Type assertion to extract signal-specific error and call Data() for retry with failed metric data
Type assertion to extract signal-specific error and call Data() for retry with failed profile data
Checks error chain for permanent wrapper type — chain traversal affected by structural changes
Checks error chain for downstream wrapper type — chain traversal affected by structural changes
Constructor creates permanent error wrapping a plain error — needs to wrap structured ErrorData instead
Constructor creates retryable error wrapping plain error — used inside signal-specific error constructors
Error.Unwrap() returns the wrapped error — structural change affects errors.Is/errors.As chain traversal across all consumers

exporters.description: The exporter pipeline is the primary consumer of consumererror types. The retry sender checks IsPermanent to decide whether to retry. The queue/batch implementations (traces.go, logs.go, metrics.go, profiles.go) use errors.As to extract signal-specific error types and call Data() to get failed telemetry data for retry. The OTLP HTTP and gRPC exporters create permanent errors via NewPermanent. The observability report sender extracts failure attributes using IsPermanent. All of these patterns break.

receivers.description: The receiver helper uses IsDownstream to distinguish between internal failures vs downstream refusals for observability metrics. The OTLP receiver uses IsPermanent to determine gRPC error codes. The contract checker test framework uses both IsPermanent and NewPermanent for testing scenarios.

processors.description: The batch processor creates a permanent error via NewPermanent for the errTooManyBatchers sentinel. The memory limiter processor mock also uses consumererror.

service_layer.description: The obsconsumer wrappers for all four signal types (traces, logs, metrics, profiles) use IsDownstream and NewDownstream to classify errors for telemetry attribution. Changing the error structure breaks the error chain traversal these rely on.

consumererror_package_itself.description: The core package must be restructured: Error struct changes, Retryable generic type changes, signal-specific types (Traces/Logs/Metrics) change, all constructors change, all helper functions (IsPermanent, IsDownstream, ToHTTPStatus, ToGRPCStatus) change. The internal statusconversion utilities may also need updates.

analysis.external_impact: This change affects the public API of the consumererror package (go.opentelemetry.io/collector/consumer/consumererror). Any external/contrib exporters, processors, or receivers in opentelemetry-collector-contrib or third-party components that import this package and use type assertions, IsPermanent, IsDownstream, NewPermanent, NewRetryableError, or the signal-specific error types (NewTraces, NewLogs, NewMetrics) will also break. The xconsumererror sub-package for profiles is similarly affected.
